observation: Read all delivered text. A tourism opportunity is followed by a safety-procedure gap, then the repeated locate/prepare/search/extrapolate sequence makes the summary track decisions. Ocean data and a simplified motion model feed Kalman trajectory correction; the author explicitly invokes prerequisite satisfaction, which is a claim rather than an independently checked condition. Equipment reduction uses fourteen indicators and three components; the literal PrincipleComponentAnalysis wording is retained. The search paragraph consumes the filter covariance and turns a95percent region into an operational search zone. Extrapolation separates changed seas from cooperative multiple-submersible monitoring. Sensitivity closes by comparing two larger and two smaller stated RMSEs, distinguishing parameter effects. The locate sentence splits after establishedthe; broken compounds/words remain, keyword text and a Chinese promotion line contaminate the selection. No figure/formula interpretation, validation of mathematical prerequisites or whole-source completeness acceptance.
